notes.title: Update 0.14.0 : Renown reworked
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/WtltbWwl.png[/IMG]

Level up and unlock new troops much faster with our latest update. All renown ranks are considerably lower, get ready for those 3rd tier units because you'll get them sooner than you think...

And,  to celebrate this new release, get a temporary 10% discount on all Heroes.

Have fun !

notes.title: Update 0.13.03 : let's get tactical !
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/ciDZ08X.png[/IMG]

Our latest patch is now live. We greatly reduced the frequency of elixir orbs popping during combat, putting more focus on the combat and less on the running around to collect orbs part. You were right to ask for this change. We also nerfed the Chimera and fixed a lot of other bugs. 

To celebrate all these good news, we're discount the Flesh Golem by 20% and all the renown boost by 50%!

See you all on the battlefield !

notes.title: Patch 0.13.01 : Less "killed outright", more tactics
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/kSsKlL6l.png[/IMG]

We read your feedback and this patch will fix most of the issue following the release of version 0.13.00 and the new Confrontation mode. Among many other things, we reduced the frequency of killed outright (see below), reduced the max number of units of the same type on the field, changed the number of Elixir won when killing the enemy champion to 3 and tweaked the Elixir orb spawning rules.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/219700/discussions/0/540744935878062621/]Check the changelog here for more details.[/url]

notes.title: Patch 0.12.11 is live. You can now respec your units !
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

Dogs of War Online latest patch is live. Among the many changes you'll find the long awaited abilty to respec your units, you'll need to use a specific item : the Oblivion shard. You probably already have a few on your account. Log into the game right now and finally do the tweaks you always wanted to do !

We hope you'll enjoy all the other changes. 

Have fun !

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/DZ2i3CX.png[/IMG]

notes.title: Patch 0.12.10 is live, come get your rewards !
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

The patch 0.12.10 is live and our servers are running smoothly again, it's time to come and check all the new features and especially the new level-up rewards. 
Every time you'll reach a new level you'll get ducats, healing cards and colors for your units. 
And if you already passed a few level, when you'll log into the game you'll get all the rewards you missed. No time to lose, launch the game to collect your prize and improve your company.

But this is not the only change. We listened to your complaints about the reduced maps with invisble walls and we replaced them by larger maps with borders (you were right, it's much better with borders). 
We also improved the friend sponsoring feature. It's now much easier to find and to use and the rewards are better. Just go to your profil page to start inviting your friends.
Among the many other changers, we increased the XP earned by your units in training games, changed the score goals in KOTH because games were too fast and much more...

We hope you'll enjoy these changes. 
No more reading, it's battle time !

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/P8NFwX2.png[/IMG]

notes.title: Random loot, alternate deployment zones, better balancing... patch 0.12.9 is live
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/gyGhJba.jpg[/IMG]

Dogs Of War Online latest patch is live with many updates and improvement. Loot random rewards after battle, discover the new alternate deployment zone and the better balanced units. We also removed the ranking limit on the purchase of new units, merged the 200 and 300 brackets in a single 250 bracket, among many other things. 

Launch the game now to check all the new features !
